North Dakota Recorders Information Network
Marriage License
To obtain a Marriage License in Barnes County, you must apply for a Marriage License at the Office of County Recorder on the second floor in the Barnes County Courthouse.
More Info
Office of the County Recorder
The Office of the County Recorder (formerly Register of Deeds) is responsible for recording and processing all legal documents related to real estate. These documents include deeds, mortgages, assignments, satisfactions, liens, leases, plats, letters testamentary, patents, easements, and other related documents. (Mechanics Liens)
All recordings are open to the public during normal business hours.
A document presented for recording or filing must be sufficiently legible to reproduce a readable copy using the county recorders of title’s current method of reproduction.
We file all underground installation cards. North Dakota land survey monument records are filed in each individual county.
As custodians of vital records of the county, we have the responsibility of protecting and preserving the proof of rights of property ownership.
The Recorder’s office also issues Passports, handles county marriage licenses and can perform marriage ceremonies.

Accessibility Commitment for Barnes County
At Barnes County , we are committed to making our digital presence as accessible and inclusive as reasonably possible for all users, including individuals with disabilities. Our goal is to improve the usability of https://www.barnescounty.us and to support a more accessible experience for everyone, regardless of their abilities or the technologies they use.
Our Approach to Accessibility
We aim to align with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) Version 2.1 Level AA, which define internationally recognized standards for digital accessibility. While full compliance cannot always be guaranteed, we strive to implement improvements where feasible and regularly review accessibility-related aspects of our website. Accessibility is an ongoing process, and we are committed to improving the experience over time as technologies, standards, and user needs evolve.
While some older portable document format (PDF) documents do not quite meet the WCAG 2.1 AA standard on our site, we are working to update those as soon as possible. If there is a particular document that is not quite updated to the standards of your needs, please to not hesitate to contact us.
Accessibility Features
To support accessibility, https://www.barnescounty.us may utilize tools such as the OneTap accessibility toolbar. This interface provides users with a range of helpful features, including:
Adjustable text size and contrast settings
Highlighting of links and text for better visibility
Full keyboard navigation of the toolbar interface
Please note the following:
The availability and effectiveness of these features depend on the website's configuration and ongoing maintenance.
While we strive to ensure accessibility, we cannot guarantee that every part of https://www.barnescounty.us will be fully accessible at all times. Some content may be provided by third parties or affected by technical constraints beyond our immediate control.
Contact and Feedback Information:
To provide contact or feedback on the accessibility of our site, please contact us:
Phone: (701) 845-8545 Extension 1
E-Mail: webmaster@barnescounty.us
Exceptions
Certain archived data such as PDFs or embedded maps may not fully confirm to WCAG 2.1AA requirements. If you need access to this information, please contact us.
